description:
QuotesApp lets you read and save quotes. It helps you stay motivated by providing best picked quotes stated by famous personalities. This app uses zen quotes API for retrieving quotes.
It has useful features, such as daily dose of wisdom through a notification, bookmarks to save the quotes that you find motivating and keeping them in a separated section as well as capturing beautiful images of the quotes with the share button.
Moreover, there are a number of cool transition and animation affects, like slide to refresh, which makes navigation much cooler. Long pressing a quote in your Bookmarks copies it to the clipboard... More features along the way.
